data.one_liner: A wrapper widget that makes a Floating Action Button draggable to screen edges.
data.what_it_does: It wraps a FloatingActionButton to allow users to drag it around the screen. The widget snaps or moves to the edges of the screen based on user interaction.
use_when: You want to give users the ability to reposition a Floating Action Button.
You need a simple wrapper widget for an existing FloatingActionButton without complex setup.
avoid_when: You need a non-FAB draggable element (use other gesture or overlay tools instead).
You require complex custom physics or non-edge snapping behaviors not documented.
strengths: Easy to integrate as a wrapper around standard FloatingActionButtons.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: No explicit alternatives from the catalog list.
